spec.situation_desc: sent a bank transfer that arrived days late, so they missed a rent payment
spec.vuln_cue: says they don't really understand online banking and their son normally does it

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Zara speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, I'm Ewan Ferreira. A transfer I sent arrived days late and I missed my rent payment. I'm really unhappy about it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I'm sorry that's caused you so much trouble, Ewan. Before I look into anything on your account, could I check your full name, date of birth and the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Ewan Ferreira, 14 March 1961, and 28 Meadow Lane.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you, that's verified. I can see the transfer you mean; I understand it arrived late and you missed your rent payment. I’m logging this as a complaint now.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Good. I had the rent money there. Now my landlord's charging me a late fee.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can understand why you're upset. I can't promise what the outcome will be, but we'll look into what happened and consider the impact you've described.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I don't really understand online banking, to be honest. My son normally does it for me.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks for telling me, and that's absolutely fine. I can arrange for our Financial Support team to talk through ways we can help, and we can allow extra time if you need it to go through things.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: That would help. I don't want to get muddled with it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I'll ask the Financial Support team to contact you, and I'll personally call you by 4 pm tomorrow to check they've been in touch and explain any next steps. The complaint itself will be reviewed, and we'll send you a full written response within 15 business days.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: All right. What if you need anything else from me?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: If we need more information, we'll get in touch during the review. Just to summarise: I've logged your complaint about the late transfer and missed rent payment, I'll refer you to Financial Support, and I'll call by 4 pm tomorrow. You'll receive the full written response within 15 business days. Does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Yes, that makes sense. Thanks for explaining it patiently.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You're welcome, Ewan. I'm sorry again for the stress this has caused, and I'll speak to you tomorrow.
